item.title: The History of the AI Agent Harness
item.description: Most of the recent gains in AI agents came from the software wrapped around the model, not the weights. A history of the harness in three stages — the token loop, the static harness, and the harness that improves itself — alongside YC’s own path from a shared bot to a centralised multi-user agent system.
